name: Naiad Raider

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-03: A Foot in the Door

special.label: when Shoving with their aqueous maul

items.name: Animal Empathy
items.text: The naiad can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals.

items.name: Break Legs!
items.text:
The naiad raider makes a maul Strike against an adjacent creature If it hits, the creature is knocked Prone and becomes Clumsy 1 for 1 minute As long as this clumsy condition lasts, the creature also takes a –5-foot penalty to its Speeds and has weakness 5 to the naiad raider's Strikes.

Effect: Break Legs!

items.name: Rushing Strike
items.text: The naiad raider Strides twice If they end their movement within melee reach of an enemy, they can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

items.name: Stampeding Shove
items.text: The naiad raider Shoves a creature, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to their Athletics check if the target is Prone. If the Shove succeeds, the target takes 2d10 bludgeoning damage (double damage on a critical success).

text:
Criminal organizations are always happy to loan out money at exorbitant rates, and their legbreakers are always happy to collect.

---
In the underbelly of society, the lawless reign supreme.
